calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6
  AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-05'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 30

SELECT date_trunc('week', sale_date) AS wk, count(*) AS dup_groups, sum(c-1) AS extra_rows
FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, min(sale_date) AS sale_date, count(*) AS c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT min(sale_date) AS min_d, max(sale_date) AS max_d, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT sale_date) AS days,
       sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_p6,
       min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE (receipt_id, line_no) IN (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
nl AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT sum(v) AS s FROM nl WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26'),
ctl AS (SELECT sum(net_sales) AS s FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND store_id <> 999),
dups AS (SELECT count(*) AS web_dup_rows FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND (receipt_id, line_no) IN (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1))
SELECT mine.s AS mine, ctl.s AS control, mine.s - ctl.s AS gap, dups.web_dup_rows FROM mine, ctl, dups

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
nl AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_then, f.net_amount AS v, f.standard_cost AS c
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category AS cat_asis, n.cat_then AS cat_aswas, count(*) AS n_lines, sum(v) AS net_sales, sum(v - c) AS gm
FROM nl n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT cp.category,
  count(*) AS lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL OR f.standard_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_cost,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost > f.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_gt_net,
  min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_channel
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1
